_comment: OVERBOUGHT take-profit exit calibration. Forces UseOverbought=1; exits when RSI and Stoch %D are simultaneously in their overbought zones. Run only if the screen kept UseOverbought ON. go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker SFIN -strategy reversion -interval Day1 -calibrate data/params/sfin/reversion_cal_overbought.json -out ./reports/SFIN_ob -months 50 -test-months 12 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20
